Treats and prevents eye disease and neglected tropical diseases, including deworming. GiveWell published 3 public models of its work; the most recent, from April 2023, puts it at **5.8× GiveDirectly (GW: 15× cash)**.

GiveWell states results as multiples of its cash benchmark. GiveDirectly itself scores about 2.6× that benchmark in GiveWell's own model, so GiveWell's multiples look 2.6 times smaller here, where everything is compared with GiveDirectly.

| Model | By | Date | Result | Cells reproduced |

| [Cost-effectiveness of April 2023 Sightsavers DRC grant](/sightsavers) | GW | April 2023 | 5.8× GiveDirectly (GW: 15× cash) | 9 |
| [Cost-effectiveness of January 2023 Sightsavers grant](/sightsavers/sightsavers-cost-effectiveness-january-2023) | GW | January 2023 | 7.1× GiveDirectly (GW: 19× cash) | 2 |
| [Sightsavers Cameroon and Nigeria cost-effectiveness [December 2021]](/sightsavers/sightsavers-cameroon-nigeria-cost-effectiveness) | GW | December 2021 | 5.2× GiveDirectly (GW: 13× cash) | 1 |
